name: NTE Damage Chain Reaction
description: Creates independent native damage-trigger chains from real player-to-target CharacterOnDamaged events. Core uses only the validated DamageTriggerActor trigger path and binds each chain to the original target. No captured GameplayEffect call replay, simulated input, skill activation, animation replay, or direct HP writes. A chain ends when repeated damage cannot be confirmed or the feature is stopped.
author: Rabb1t79
